messages:
alina_marketing: Hey team — planning the launch webinar next Wed. We want a short slide showing latency/cost across short/medium/long contexts for the quantized v1 model and the float baseline. Can eng/runtime help with a targeted rerun? Need clear method notes we can paste into the blog and a tiny artifact pack for the deck.

Derek_runtime: Yep — we can run. Quick q: which model checkpoints exactly (name+commit) and which quantization profiles? Also do you need cold-starts included or just steady-state after warmup?

alina_marketing: Model: redwood/llama-13B@v1.2.3 and float baseline redwood/llama-13B@v1.2.2. Quant: int8 and q4_0 variants. Include cold-starts (first request on warm host) plus steady-state percentiles. Primary asks: 50th/90th/95th latencies, tokens/sec, and cost-per-1k-tokens. Deadline: slides by Tue noon PT.

Sasha_eng: Got it. Proposed methodology: stratified traffic by sequence length: short (<=64 tokens), medium (256±64), long (1024±256). Sample 2k requests per bucket, random prompt selection from the marketing sample pack link you posted. Warmup: 5 requests per replica using the same short prompts, then measure 10k-request steady window. Produce histograms, pct breakdown, and raw perf traces for 95th tail investigation. Does that sound OK?

jordan_product: pls include a small slice with mixed function-calls payloads — our demo uses tool calls and it affects tokenization/warmup patterns.

Derek_runtime: Agree with Sasha. For cold-start measurements we should control for GPU allocation latency vs model load. Options: (A) measure cold-start including model load (real user case) or (B) measure with preloaded weights but empty KV cache. Which does marketing want called out on the slide?

alina_marketing: Call out both. On the slide show the steady-state numbers, but in the notes call out typical cold-start delta and link to the raw traces. If it helps, mark the cold-start numbers with an asterisk.

Sasha_eng: Perfect. I'll kick off two jobs: "launch-webinar/steady" and "launch-webinar/coldstart" with the following run config (examples):

```
bench-run --model redwood/llama-13B@v1.2.3 --quant q4_0 --buckets "short,medium,long" --samples-per-bucket 2000 --warmup 5 --steady-window 10000 --collect pctiles=50,90,95 --artifacts hist,trace,raw-logs --tag webinar-launch
```

I will also run float baseline for parity. We will redact any user tokens and keep payloads internal. Expected runtime: ~3h per job.

Derek_runtime: One more: confirm whether marketing needs per-token cost using current pricing assumptions or a normalized unit cost. We can produce both but pricing requires you to confirm rate card (hosted vs dedicated).

alina_marketing: For the slide use normalized cost (cost units per 1k tokens) + a separate appendix mapping to hosted pricing. Use hosted pricing baseline; we can patch exact dollar numbers later with finance.

Sasha_eng: Cool. Plan: run quant and float variants, generate CSV of pctiles, hist images (png), a 1-page methodology note (md), and a tarball with raw-logs for deeper analysis. Will upload artifacts to the marketing S3 bucket and paste links here when done. ETA: Tue 10:30am PT. Need signoff on retention (we keep raw logs for 30 days) and on including function-call slice.

alina_marketing: Signoff for 30 days retention is fine. Include function-call slice. Please prioritize the steady window artifacts for slides first.

benchbot: Job scheduled: job_id=jb_2026032101, queued by sasha_eng, est_duration=3h, artifacts=hist,trace,raw-logs. Link: https://bench.internal/jobs/jb_2026032101

Sasha_eng: Thanks — starting now. I'll ping when steady artifacts uploaded.

alina_marketing: Amazing, thank you! :rocket: If anything slips, flag immediately so we can adjust slide plan.
